newsitem.title: MEXICO: S&P assigns highest rating to Telmex paper.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns highest rating to Telmex paper.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday that it had assigned a rating of mxA-1+ to a one-year commercial paper issue worth 3.0 billion pesos from Telefonos de Mexico, S.A. de C.V.
The rating is the highest on the CaVal scale and "indicates an extraordinary grade of security in respect to the payment of interest and principle," S&P said in a statement.

S&P said the rating is based on Telmex's modern technology, its leading position in the telecommunications sector and its financial solidity, as reflected in its strong capitalizaiton, solid operating margins and strong cash generation.

"We do not see that the credit profile of the company will be affected significantly by the opening of the sector, given the improvement in the quality of Telmex's service and its new mix of revenues from service derived from the tariff rebalancing," S & P said.
The CaVal scale is used to rate local-currency debt.
